configField.description: The field that is used in data spec toPartiallyAppliedActions

argumentSpecField.description: The argument spec field that is associated with config field

transformFunction.description:
The transform function name to use to transform the original field value.
This function should be implemented at component's data spec type. If configDependence
is defined, the function will be called with two arguments: the value of the configField
and the component configuration. Otherwise, the function will be called with
only the value of the configField as the argument.

configDependence.description:
This is a flag that indicates that the transformFunction depends on other fields
in the component configuration and thus the component configuration should be passed
in along with the configField value.

overrideValue.description: This field serves as the value to be used instead of the configField value.

name: UiSdlCrossTypeDataSpecDependence
